prompt: A highly photorealistic 3:4 vertical full-body fashion portrait of a stunning adult East Asian woman standing inside an elegant, dimly lit luxury interior. She wears an elegant strapless evening gown: a fitted black floral-lace bustier bodice with delicate scalloped lace along the neckline, opaque lining beneath the lace for tasteful coverage, a structured black satin waistband, and a large deep olive-black satin ribbon bow tied at the front of her waist with two long ribbon tails. The dress continues into a voluminous floor-length skirt made of layered dark navy-black chiffon, creating soft vertical folds and a graceful flowing silhouette. Minimal jewelry: delicate drop earrings, a very thin pendant necklace, and a pale jade bangle on one wrist. Her body is turned slightly at a three-quarter angle while her shoulders remain relaxed. One arm is lifted gracefully with the elbow pointing outward; the wrist bends softly downward and the relaxed fingertips hover just below her chin without touching it. Her other arm hangs naturally beside her body. Her head is held slightly back with her chin subtly raised, creating an elegant editorial pose. Keep the hands slender, relaxed and anatomically correct. She stands beside glossy black paneled walls and tall antique mirror panels with thin brass framing. Warm golden wall sconces and their reflections glow softly in the dark mirrors, while a polished pale marble floor catches faint highlights. The setting feels like a luxurious vintage hotel corridor or private dressing salon, with rich black, gold and deep navy tones. Warm cinematic tungsten lighting, soft frontal fill light on her face and dress, gentle shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic lace, satin and chiffon textures, natural body proportions, crisp facial focus, refined editorial photography, 50mm lens, authentic camera realism, elegant and atmospheric without looking staged or artificial. Avoid malformed hands, extra fingers, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, anime style, CGI appearance, motion blur, text, logos and watermarks.
